notes: This release requires a licence key. Docket has been free to run while the site sold it at $199; from 1.1.59 an audit needs the key from your purchase email. Open the app and run an audit and it will ask for the key, or run docket licence --key YOUR-KEY. Activation did not exist before today — the app would have asked for a key with nowhere to enter one — so this release is as much about that as about the gate.
